integrity: General theorem proved algebraically from cubic Kummer/Frobenius action and exact finite-field cubic-trace counts; independent prime-field test programs corroborate but do not constitute infinite-case proof. A related characteristic-one-modulo-three classification has disjoint domain; an unindexed equivalent treatment remains a priority risk. No independent audit is claimed.
limitations: Only smooth coefficient-marked curves over odd prime powers congruent to two modulo three; not isomorphism classes, other characteristics/congruence classes, curve zeta functions, superspeciality or Newton polygons.
title: Four arithmetic Weierstrass spectra in the cyclic-six genus-four hyperelliptic family
